descriptions.text: Enchanted headband. The Wrap of Sekhmet's Compassion. This item may only be equipped by a pet. Eternal Protector of Health. Pet will become temporarily invulnerable and will gain the Heal Party Member skill if it is within three meters of its owner and its owner's health is below 10%. Invulnerability will last 60 seconds and can only trigger once per day. Bringer of Resurrection. Fatal bites from this pet have a 75% chance to cast a level 10 Raise Bootlicker on the corpse.

recap.text: Rend wears a red Rambo-style headband from Donut's class, the Wrap of Sekhmet's Compassion, which gives sixty seconds of invulnerability and Heal Party Member once a day, and a 75 percent chance that a fatal bite casts a level 10 Raise Bootlicker. Bigs asks why she got no hat, and Carl says she is a mercenary. Rend dies for the sixth time, returns 25 percent stronger and weak to potatoes, with the headband half over his eyes.

beats.headline: A headband for Rend
beats.text: The second pet accessory from Donut's class is more a headband than a hat: a red piece of fabric, Rambo-style, until a closer look shows the rich red covered with an intricate pattern Carl cannot quite make out. It does almost what Mongo's nemes does. Eternal Protector of Health: sixty seconds of invulnerability and the Heal Party Member skill, once a day, when the pet is within three meters of an owner under ten percent health. Bringer of Resurrection: a 75 percent chance that a fatal bite casts a level 10 Raise Bootlicker on the corpse. Holy hell, says Carl. Bigs asks why she got no hat, and Carl tells her she is not a pet: she is technically a mercenary.
beats.gist: Carl tells Bigs she gets no hat because she is a mercenary, not a pet.

beats.headline: Bouncing for it
beats.text: Back in the garage, Rend sits in a circle with Splash Zone, Dong and Mongo, watching Hedy balance a wrench and giggling in his deep baritone, raw French fries falling from his mouth. Donut produces Mongo's Egyptian hat, and Dong helps the dinosaur wear it. Rend starts grunting and bouncing up and down as Donut produces the headband.
beats.gist: Rend bounces and grunts as Donut produces the headband, after Dong helps Mongo wear the Egyptian hat.

beats.headline: Left on guard duty
beats.text: The garage door opens on a different world, and Donut tells Mongo and Rend to stay behind with Splashy and Dong and guard Hedy. Mongo screams in protest, waving his wings, and Rend, wearing his new headband, complains loudly too. Dong salutes as the door closes.
beats.gist: Donut orders Mongo and Rend to stay with Splashy and Dong and guard Hedy; they protest loudly.

beats.headline: Half over his eyes
beats.text: Rend giggles as he rises from the dead. It is his sixth death, so he keeps his memories and identity and comes back 25 percent stronger, with a new random weakness: potatoes. Carl shouts at the ceiling that random, his ass. Mongo dances around the awake Rend. The Tummy Acher is bigger now, and the headband from Donut's class has stayed on him, sitting slightly lower and half covering his eyes. He gives a deep giggle and turns to the garage door as if nothing has happened.
beats.gist: Rend rises from his sixth death stronger, newly weak to potatoes, with Donut's headband half over his eyes.

beats.headline: Kept on for the parade
beats.text: Rend marches in the float procession's marching band with Mongo, Simoom, Gonk and Bianca. Donut's new Gurkha class has brought some pretty wild clothes for all the mercenaries and pets, but for this fight the crew keeps the headband on Rend and the nemes on Mongo, and the mounts get black-and-gold blankets that raise their constitution by 20 percent.
beats.gist: Rend keeps his headband and Mongo the nemes; the mounts get constitution-raising black-and-gold blankets.

relations.note: a pet accessory that came with her class
